transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our pre-load coordination huddle started. We have three loads ready for movement to the support site during the 0700-1300 window: a clinic cold-chain pallet, a generator replacement pallet, and a routine administrative-supplies pallet. Our available transport is Trucks T-1, T-2, and T-3. Before I approve any vehicle assignments and loading sequence, I need each of you to report any current handling or receiving requirements. Transportation, maintenance control, and medical logistics -- what do you have for me?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, during this morning's vehicle check I confirmed that only Truck T-2 has a functioning refrigerated-power inverter approved for the clinic cold-chain pallet. That equipment note hasn't been added to the movement worksheet yet, so the cold-chain pallet needs to go on T-2.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, during the current axle inspection I confirmed that Truck T-3 is limited to 2,500 kilograms, while the generator pallet weighs 3,200 kilograms. That revised limitation hasn't been entered on the vehicle status board yet, so T-3 cannot carry the generator pallet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, I confirmed with the receiving clinic that they have fixed appointment times for each load: 0900 for the cold-chain pallet, 1030 for the generator pallet, and 1200 for the administrative-supplies pallet. This appointment sheet hasn't been cross-referenced with the movement plan yet, so we need to factor these receiving times into our vehicle assignments and loading sequence.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Load and dispatch the clinic cold-chain pallet first to meet the 0900 receiving appointment, then the generator replacement pallet for 1030, then the administrative-supplies pallet for 1200.

Cold-chain pallet assigned to T-2 (refrigerated inverter requirement), generator pallet assigned to T-1 (T-3 weight-limited at 2,500 kg, generator is 3,200 kg), administrative-supplies pallet assigned to T-3.
Update the movement worksheet with T-2 refrigerated inverter note and update the vehicle status board with T-3's 2,500 kg weight limitation.
